hero.sub: Premium hoodies, sweatshirts and tees in organic cotton, oversized fit, soft colours. Pieces made to last. Born from a friendship.

story.lead: KODA is two friends who couldn't find the perfect hoodie: heavy enough to last for years, soft enough to never take off, in colours you don't see everywhere. So we made it. No overstock, no compromise, no bullshit.
story.v1: 330 gsm hoodie, 300 gsm sweatshirt, brushed inside, ribbed trims. Pieces you keep, not ones you replace.
story.v2: No loud logo, no disposable trend. Simple pieces, worn by us first.
story.v3: For the people who make it, the planet, and you: fair prices, made to order, free returns.

specs.title: Heavy outside,
specs.fabricText: Hoodie: 70% certified organic cotton, 30% certified recycled polyester, 330 gsm. Sweatshirt: 65% cotton, 35% recycled polyester, 300 gsm. Tee: 60% cotton, 40% polyester, 180 gsm.
specs.fitText: Slightly oversized, unisex, drop shoulders on the sweatshirt. Model 1m75 wears S, model 1m85 wears M.
specs.detailsText: Hood with round drawcords, set-in sleeves, ribbed cuffs and hem, brushed inside, Koda embroidery.
specs.makingText: Small batches: pieces made to last, not to follow trends.
specs.careText: Wash at 30°, inside out, no tumble dryer. It ages well if you respect it.
